title: Affinity Review (2026)
intro: Relationship intelligence CRM for private capital teams with Essential through Advanced annual seat pricing. This review covers pricing posture, CRM capabilities, limitations, and fit based on first-party research — not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Affinity overall score 6.7/10 from equal-weight CRM criteria. Essential $2000, Scale $2300, Advanced $2700 per user/year. Enterprise custom quote.
verdict: Affinity: Choose Affinity when private capital relationship CRM is the primary need and annual seat budgets allow. Scores reflect first-party research as of 2026-08-16 — not hands-on product testing.
